info.title: Glider V2 API
info.description:
The Glider V2 API is a REST surface for integrator partners to create rebalance strategies, enroll end-users into them, and monitor or withdraw the resulting portfolios.

**Mental model.** A *strategy* is a reusable template (allocation + schedule + swap preferences). A *portfolio* is one end-user's mirror of a strategy with one smart account per chain. Every portfolio enrolled in a strategy mirrors the same allocation; publishing a new strategy version causes enrolled portfolios to re-target on their next scheduled rebalance.

**Rebalances.** Each portfolio runs on the strategy's schedule (`hourly`/`daily`/`weekly`/`monthly`). Integrators can also dispatch an out-of-band run with `POST /v2/portfolios/{id}/rebalance` — useful when an end-user wants to capture or hedge market volatility without waiting for the next tick. Runtime visibility (`nextDueAt`, `lastRebalanceAt`) lives on `GET /v2/portfolios/{id}` under `schedule`, not on the strategy.

**Asset coverage.** Allocations accept any CAIP-19 asset Glider supports — ERC-20 tokens, SPL tokens, and tokenized real-world assets (equities, treasuries) sourced through Glider's upstream data providers. Token metadata, balances, and USD prices are returned uniformly via `GET /v2/portfolios/{id}/positions`.

**Chain abstraction.** Glider's wallet infrastructure handles cross-chain deposit routing and asset migrations between supported chains. Integrators do not need to plan for client-side migrations when a chain is sunset or a strategy moves liquidity venues.

**Conventions.** Authentication uses API keys (`x-api-key` header) with per-scope access. All identifiers are CAIP-10/CAIP-19 so the same shape works across EVM and non-EVM chains. All monetary values are decimal strings — never numbers — to preserve precision across JSON round-trips.

**Terms.** Use of this API is governed by Glider's B2B API terms (see `termsOfService`). Integrators are responsible for surfacing applicable terms to their own end-users.

get.description: Returns Glider's public + mirrorable strategies for the chosen `collection` — `curated` (a hand-picked set, in editorial order) or `top_performing` (analytics-ranked). Both are keyset-paginated: follow `nextCursor` to page through results, keeping `collection` stable across pages. For `top_performing` the cursor encodes its `sort`, so `sort` need not be re-sent (if sent, it must match). Requires a valid API key; no scope.

schema.description: Which catalog to return. `curated` = a hand-picked set of strategies in editorial order. `top_performing` = analytics-ranked (see `sort`).

parameters.description: Which catalog to return. `curated` = a hand-picked set of strategies in editorial order. `top_performing` = analytics-ranked (see `sort`).
parameters.name: collection

schema.description: Ranking for `top_performing`: `tvl.desc` (TVL), `inflows7d.desc` (7-day net inflows), `users.desc` (active users). Ignored for `curated`. Defaults to `tvl.desc`.

parameters.description: Ranking for `top_performing`: `tvl.desc` (TVL), `inflows7d.desc` (7-day net inflows), `users.desc` (active users). Ignored for `curated`. Defaults to `tvl.desc`.
parameters.name: sort

schema.description: Max items per page (1–50) for both `curated` and `top_performing`. Follow `nextCursor` to page beyond the first set.

parameters.description: Max items per page (1–50) for both `curated` and `top_performing`. Follow `nextCursor` to page beyond the first set.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Pass the previous response's `nextCursor` verbatim.

post.description: Stage 1 of the two-stage enroll flow. Validates that the calling tenant can enroll users in the `strategyId`, resolves or allocates an automation agent, and returns the wallet authorization payload. For EVM enrollment, stage 1 reads a candidate account index but does not reserve it; stage 2 commits the index only after signature verification. SVM enrollment uses `accountIndex: "0"` as a compatibility placeholder. The response's `flowId`, `accountIndex`, and `agentAccountId` must all be passed back verbatim to `POST /v2/enroll`.

post.summary: Create a portfolio for an enrolled user
post.description: Stage 2 of the two-stage enroll flow. Consumes the `flowId` + `accountIndex` + `agentAccountId` returned by `POST /v2/enroll/signature` plus the user's `signature` over the session-key message. Verifies the signature, creates the mirror strategy instance, one smart account per chain, and a rebalance schedule row derived from the strategy's execution config — all inside a single transaction. The whole operation is idempotent on `(tenantId, apiKeyId, "POST /v2/enroll", flowId)` via the `v2_idempotency_keys` store; a replay with the same body returns the cached response, a replay with a different body returns 409.

400.description: Invalid request, unknown strategy, expired flow, expired signed Solana transaction, or invalid signature

409.description: Idempotency replay-in-progress, key-conflict, user already enrolled, or an active registration for the derived Solana sub-account

503.description: Portfolio committed but indexing registration is temporarily unavailable; retry the exact same flowId

get.description: Returns the authenticated tenant's portfolios with optional filtering by `ownerAccountId`, `strategyId`, and `status`. Live balances and positions are served by `GET /v2/portfolios/{portfolioId}/positions`. Cursor-paginated, most recently created first; use the opaque `nextCursor` to fetch the next page.

schema.description: Filter to a single end-user's portfolios under this tenant. CAIP-10 account identifier — for EVM use the chain-agnostic form `eip155:0:0x<address>`.

parameters.description: Filter to a single end-user's portfolios under this tenant. CAIP-10 account identifier — for EVM use the chain-agnostic form `eip155:0:0x<address>`.
parameters.name: ownerAccountId

parameters.description: Filter to portfolios mirroring a specific strategy
parameters.name: strategyId

schema.description: Filter by rebalance schedule status. When set, portfolios without a schedule row are excluded.

parameters.description: Filter by rebalance schedule status. When set, portfolios without a schedule row are excluded.

get.description: Returns real-time per-asset balances and USD values for a portfolio. The `assets[]` array spans every asset class the underlying allocation supports — ERC-20 tokens, SPL tokens, and tokenized real-world assets (equities, treasuries) — using one uniform shape (`assetId`, `symbol`, `decimals`, `balance`, `balanceRaw`, `priceUsd`, `valueUsd`). Token metadata and prices are sourced from Glider's upstream data providers and passed through unchanged. Results may be cached for up to 30 seconds. Partial failures are surfaced in `warnings[]` and do not fail the request — the endpoint returns 200 with whatever loaded. For schedule/status polling (including `nextDueAt` and `lastRebalanceAt`) without live balances, use `GET /v2/portfolios/{portfolioId}` instead.

500.description: Internal server error or live balance service unavailable

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.

description.description: Strategy description. Null when none was provided.

maxApy.description: Advertised maximum APY as a decimal percentage string (e.g. "10.00" = 10%). Managed by Glider; not a computed return. Absent when no APY is advertised.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation timestamp of the strategy. Null when unknown.

canMirror.description: Always true — only mirrorable strategies appear here. Use `strategyId` with the enroll flow to mirror.

assets.description: Target assets for the strategy. Weights must sum to 100.

weight.description: Allocation weight as a string percentage. Must be > 0, up to 2 decimal places. The allocation's weights must sum to 100.

tvlUsd.description: Total value locked across the strategy's active portfolios, as a USD decimal string rounded to 2 decimal places. Null when the value is temporarily unavailable — never conflated with a real "0.00".

portfolioCount.description: Number of portfolios created from this strategy. Null when the value is temporarily unavailable — never conflated with a real 0.

window.description: Lookback window key. `all` spans the entire curve.

percentChange.description: Percent change from `since` to the last point using the response's `meta.method`. For `all` this is the curve's cumulative return.

since.description: UTC calendar date the return is anchored on. For `all` this is the curve's first point.

windows.description: Windowed lookbacks ordered shortest → longest, ending with `all`. Fixed windows that predate the curve are omitted.

StrategyPerformanceSummary.description: Target-allocation performance windows (1d…12m plus `all`), same shape as `GET /v2/strategies/{strategyId}/performance`. Fixed windows are omitted when price history is too short; `all` spans the curve.

ownerAccountId.description: End-user wallet as a CAIP-10 identifier. EVM: `eip155:0:<addr>` (chain-agnostic per CAIP-10 §Abstract Account Addresses). Solana: `solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp:<base58>` (CAIP-2 mainnet reference).

chainIds.description: Numeric chain ids the user wants smart accounts on. Must be a subset of the chains this deployment has RPCs configured for.

accountType.description: EVM Kernel owner/validator configuration. `ECDSA` uses the MultiChainECDSAValidator. `ERC1271` uses the Kernel SmartAccount validator and requires exactly one EVM chainId.

agentAccountId.description: Pooled KMS agent as a chain-agnostic CAIP-10 identifier (`eip155:0:<addr>`) that will operate the smart account post-enrollment. Must be round-tripped verbatim to `POST /v2/enroll`.

accountIndex.description: Enrollment account index. For EVM, this is a candidate index that stage 1 does not reserve. For SVM, it is the compatibility placeholder `"0"`. Must be round-tripped to `POST /v2/enroll`.

accountType.description: EVM Kernel owner/validator configuration used to build `message`. Round-trip this to `POST /v2/enroll` when present.

flowId.description: Opaque flow identifier valid for 24 hours. Must be round-tripped to `POST /v2/enroll` and also serves as the idempotency anchor there.

raw.description: 32-byte hex hash. The user signs this via EIP-191 personal_sign in their EVM wallet.

ownerAccountId.description: End-user wallet as a CAIP-10 identifier. EVM: `eip155:0:<addr>`. Solana: `solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp:<base58>`.

chainIds.description: Numeric chain ids the user wants smart accounts on. Must be a subset of the chains this deployment has RPCs configured for.

accountType.description: EVM Kernel owner/validator configuration. Must match the value used for `POST /v2/enroll/signature`. `ERC1271` requires exactly one EVM chainId.

accountIndex.description: Enrollment account index as a decimal string. For EVM, stage 1 returns a candidate index that is committed only after stage 2 verifies the signature. SVM returns `"0"` as a compatibility placeholder. Must round-trip from `POST /v2/enroll/signature` into `POST /v2/enroll`.

agentAccountId.description: Pooled KMS agent CAIP-10 returned by `POST /v2/enroll/signature`. Must round-trip verbatim so the server can recompute the signable message. EVM (`eip155:0:<addr>`) or Solana (`solana:<ref>:<base58>`).

signature.description: Signature over the stage-1 message. Hex (EVM ECDSA / SVM Model A) or base58. Required for every path EXCEPT the SVM B2B subaccount path, which instead returns `signedSolanaTransaction`.

flowId.description: Opaque flow identifier. Valid for 24h. Also the idempotency anchor for `POST /v2/enroll`.

portfolioName.description: Integrator-provided display name for the portfolio. Trimmed server-side. Max 64 characters. Supports Unicode letters, digits, spaces, and - _ . ' : ( ) & /.
Integrator-provided display name for the portfolio. Null when the portfolio was created without one.

smartAccounts.description: Canonical SmartAccount objects, one per requested chain. Deterministic CREATE2 addresses.

accountId.description: CAIP-10 account identifier for the smart account (Kernel smart account). Always chain-bound — the same smart account address on a different chain is a different account.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.

portfolioName.description: Integrator-provided display name for the portfolio. Null when the portfolio was created without one.

ownerAccountId.description: End-user wallet as a chain-agnostic CAIP-10 identifier (`eip155:0:<addr>`). Null only for legacy rows without an owner recorded.

strategyName.description: Strategy display name at read time

strategyDescription.description: Strategy description as set by the integrator at strategy creation time. Null when the strategy was created without one.

smartAccounts.description: Per-chain smart accounts owned by this portfolio. Each entry is the canonical `SmartAccount` object.

status.description: Portfolio rebalance schedule status. `active` = scheduler will tick. `paused` = integrator has paused automation.

frequency.description: Resolved cadence enum. Null when the stored spec uses a non-standard `intervalMs` that does not map to the enum.

intervalMs.description: Raw interval between rebalances in milliseconds

nextDueAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the next scheduled rebalance. Use this to render 'next rebalance in …' UI or to decide whether to trigger a manual rebalance now. Null when the schedule is paused or no next tick has been computed yet.

lastRebalanceAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the most recent rebalance run (manual or scheduled). Null until the portfolio's first rebalance completes.

PortfolioSchedule.description: Rebalance schedule projection. Null when no rebalance schedule has been created for this portfolio.

totalValueUsd.description: Total USD value as a decimal string, `.toFixed(6)`. Sum of asset `valueUsd` for a single portfolio.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which balances + prices were read

smartAccounts.description: Smart accounts configured for this portfolio. Always present regardless of whether live balances loaded.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered while loading positions (e.g. a chain was unavailable, a price was missing). Empty array means a fully-healthy read.

totalUsd.description: USD value as a decimal string, `.toFixed(6)`

items.description: Open bridge legs included in totalValueUsd but not yet reflected as destination-chain asset rows.

PortfolioInTransit.description: Open bridge value included in totalValueUsd but not yet visible as settled destination-chain asset rows.

sourceAssetId.description: Source asset identifier used for the in-transit bridge leg. This matches the source asset id used internally for the portfolio position.

destinationChainId.description: Destination EVM chain id for the bridge leg.

amountRaw.description: Raw integer token balance as a decimal string (no decimals applied). The on-chain `uint256` amount before dividing by `10^decimals`.

valueUsd.description: USD value as a decimal string, `.toFixed(6)`

assetId.description: CAIP-19 asset identifier (fully chain-qualified). Covers ERC-20, SPL, and tokenized RWA assets — the same shape regardless of asset class.

smartAccountId.description: CAIP-10 account identifier for the smart account (Kernel smart account). Always chain-bound — the same smart account address on a different chain is a different account.

symbol.description: Asset symbol as reported by the upstream data provider (e.g. `USDC`, `MORPHO`, or a tokenized-equity ticker).

decimals.description: Integer exponent used to convert `balanceRaw` to `balance`. The only non-string financial field on the v2 surface.

balance.description: Human-readable token balance as a decimal string

balanceRaw.description: Raw integer token balance as a decimal string (no decimals applied). The on-chain `uint256` amount before dividing by `10^decimals`.

priceUsd.description: Unit price in USD as a decimal string, `.toFixed(6)`

valueUsd.description: USD value as a decimal string, `.toFixed(6)`
